_comment: Model pricing in USD per million tokens. Updated: Sep 12 2026
_note: Google AI free tier has no cost, but we track usage for analytics

gemini-3.8-flash.description: Active Google Studio model (config google_studio_model). Introductory pricing $0.75/$3.75 through Dec 31 2026; $1.50/$7.50 from Jan 1 2027. Source: cloud.google.com Gemini pricing (2026-09-12)

gemini-3.5-flash.description: Previous-gen flash (May 2026 rates, ai.google.dev). Kept for historical cost records.

gemini-2.0-flash.description: Deprecated; Google shutting down June 1 2026. Migrate to a newer model.

openrouter._comment: OpenRouter costs are fetched via API, this is for reference only

deepseek._comment: Official DeepSeek API (api.deepseek.com). Values are PEAK rates; off-peak is half. Peak = Mon-Fri 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC. Source: api-docs.deepseek.com (2026-09-12)

deepseek-flash.description: Active model (deepseek_model) — DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, native multimodal. Cache-hit input: $0.014/M. Off-peak: $0.22/$0.66

deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp.description: Legacy experimental vision model (not default; deepseek-flash handles images natively). Same rates; images billed as input, max 384 tokens/image
